output.answer_markdown: The passages do not say which segment dragged down 3M's 2022 organic growth. None of them gives 2022 organic sales change by segment. The Health Care decline in passage [6] covers the first six months of 2023, not 2022.

found: 3M has four operating segments in the FY2022 10-K: Safety and Industrial; Transportation and Electronics; Health Care; and Consumer [3].
3M completed the split-off of the Food Safety business in September 2022 and deconsolidated the Aearo Entities in July 2022 [2].
Health Care sales were down 5.2 percent in U.S. dollars in the first six months of 2023, which is outside the 2022 period asked about [6].
